head: 1025368ee63c0ae36878f70f261f29f808d9fd4e
scope: Tenant isolation, persisted ownership, identity adapter, provider assembly and cancellation-source preservation on independent-file SQLite.

orm_providers.outcome: all S1/S2/R1/R2/S3 tests and the 22 S3 review probes pass; 2 additional formal-DI audit regressions pass

code_generator_full.outcome: only the three agreed CCCREPO G red baselines fail; tenant-filter layering caused no unrelated regression

dependency_boundaries.failed_scope: existing ControlPlane reference-data evidence-ledger guards for #69, unrelated to #130; includes the new Data.Core/EFCore/SqlSugar references

implementation.sdk_tenant: FreeSql/SqlSugar repositories resolve ICurrentTenant per operation for reads and writes; required tenant host fails closed; optional tenants read own + shared null rows; persisted tenant ownership is checked before writes; range deletes are tenant-scoped; tenant UpdateRange is rejected; write ownership is separate from read visibility (shared null rows are host-owned)
implementation.ef_tenant_filters: generated required and DataFilter-optional expressions enforce host fail-closed/shared-only semantics; EF-specific optional keeps the documented host=all compatibility; production DbContext applies filters in host via HostCurrentTenant; persisted ownership uses AsNoTracking snapshots
implementation.assembly: SqlSugar scoped client + ISqlSugarClient alias + UoW core shared by module/extension; FreeSql UoW core shared by module/extensions; single ICurrentUserProvider adapter with fallback; FreeSql repository scanning removed
implementation.cancellation: repository entries combine caller and managed execution tokens; pre-entry managed cancellation writes zero rows
implementation.audit: provider repositories apply creation/modification/deletion audit from the scoped ICurrentUserProvider without manual SDK hook configuration

migration: SDK required-tenant host reads now throw; use an explicit governance context
SDK optional-tenant host reads only shared null rows
EF required-tenant host queries return no rows; DataFilter optional host reads only shared rows
EF-specific optional marker keeps host=all until a consumer list and migration are accepted
FreeSql extension no longer scans repository assemblies; register closed generics explicitly
SqlSugar client is scoped; repositories and UoW share the same instance
tenant-scoped UpdateRange is rejected; update entities one by one
native_gate_note: No AOT-verified formal runtime was modified in S3; ORM packages remain unverified for trim/NativeAOT.
tests_note: all suites were run serially per the maintainer instruction; reviewer probes are committed verbatim

findings.summary: EF ownership preflight reads an AsNoTracking persisted snapshot
SDK write ownership excludes shared null rows for ordinary tenants; host maintains shared rows
provider repositories write creation/modification/deletion audit through the scoped user provider
repository entries combine caller and managed execution tokens before SQL
